messages.snippet: James, FYI — Robert and Amelia signed the heads of terms last Friday (26 Sept). Key points for you:
messages.subject: Project Yarrow — heads of terms signed
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

FYI — Robert and Amelia signed the heads of terms last Friday (26 Sept). Key points for you: 7-year term, planning forecast of 540 ship-sets with a binding minimum of 417, year-1 ship-set price of £279,500, escalation at 80% CPI, and exclusivity for us through to 31 December. Indicative value about £148.4m.

Can you get going on the supply agreement draft? We'd like something to react to by mid-October.

Helena

messages.subject: RE: Project Yarrow — heads of terms signed
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena,

Noted, thank you. Those terms align with what we discussed. We'll work to the heads of terms and aim to have a first full draft of the LTSA with you by 16 October. We'll build the schedules (specification, volume commitment, pricing, service levels, warranties) around the figures you've given.

We'll send a short issues list with the draft so the commercial choices are visible.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
